lines.note: Matches the Sunamite question and army bands; omits the opening calls to return.
Matches the twin fawns; adds spiritual milk.
Divides the neck, eyes and nose description between two verses; adds kings and nations seeking her beauty.
Greek 6 is divided between Ge'ez 7 and 9, interrupted by the added golden tower of Solomon in Ge'ez 8. Ge'ez 9-10 continue with beauty, love, delights, palm and breasts.
Greek 9 is divided between Ge'ez 11-12, and Greek 10 between Ge'ez 12-13; includes added height and fragrance descriptions.
Ge'ez 15 joins the field and villages with vineyard inspection; Ge'ez 16 completes Greek 13's promise of breasts, with added fragrance and desire clauses.
